svg.title: Dormant lanes surround the clean cache
svg.desc: Use dormant lanes with inactive connection stubs around a clean cache. No moving packet or communication accent may make the awaiting population appear already active.

**Frame:** Clean Artifactory at center. Around it, dormant evaluation lanes wait to restart. No message or agent is active yet.

**Action:** The infrastructure answer closes one question and leaves another open.

**Caption:**
> IF THE BOARD WAS THE CAUSE, IT IS GONE.
>
> IF IT WAS A SOLUTION, THE PROBLEM REMAINS.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — governing Chapter 2 hypothesis, not incident fact.
